title: Parser crashes on unicode input
body:
The parser raises on any unicode string.

Steps:

```bash
pip install -e .
python -m pytest tests/test_parser.py -x
```

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/test_parser.py", line 9, in test_unicode
    parse("caf\u00e9")
  File "/home/alice/project/src/mypkg/parser.py", line 42, in parse
    return _decode(raw)
UnicodeDecodeError: 'ascii' codec can't decode byte 0xc3
```

See also src/mypkg/decoder.py for the helper.

comments.body: Reproduced on main with `parse()` and Python 3.12.
